subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The PR creates a new public Gateway surface and optional ContextEngine plugin contract, so the final API shape and admin operation policy require maintainer intent beyond the mechanical fix.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed docs/scope semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow to read-only control
options.body: Land only capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until the owner confirms maintenance semantics.

options.title: Defer the core API
options.body: Hold or close the PR if context-engine control should stay plugin/private until a broader Gateway control contract exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed docs/scope semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision touches the Gateway session ownership and context-engine integration boundaries where current history points to Vincent Koc as a recent adjacent owner.
